newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian short dated bond spreads narrow.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian short dated bond spreads narrow.

text.p: Australian bonds reclaimed some of the spread widening against U.S. and Canadian bonds that has occurred this week, and the curve flattened to its lowest level since the beginning of the month.

Despite the narrowing, which was mainly at the short end, spreads still remain above their levels of last week. The spread to U.S. 10-years closed last Friday at 100 points, while to Canadian 10-years, the margin was 66 points.
The outperformance of short dated bonds on the day saw the cash and futures curves end at their steepest levels since October 1.
While bonds closed fairly flat to New Zealand on the day, they have still outperformed them over the week.
After some overnight selling which weakened it at the open, the NZ market improved through the day although it still finished in negative territory.

Opinion polls ahead of NZ's election this weekend showing an increasing chance of the Labour party and its potential coalition partners winning power have dented the confidence seen in the market in recent weeks, traders said.
